area_metric_correction.area_units_note: Triangle cross-product norms were computed in meters; divide by 2 to obtain m2, with no additional unit scale.
area_metric_correction.reason: The original comparison field projected current triangle area onto the fixed-037 normal. That is not the construction owner full_f32_area_gate orientation metric and generated misleading signed/large ratios.
area_metric_correction.scope: emitted F32 current geometry and matched 037 reference area only; not a native or biological qualification.

comparison_limit: 403 and 404 are compared only using their already-saved full reports; replay receipts independently verify local zero on changed patches. Changed face rows are not treated as matching source triangles. Full 130/159 reruns were performed only on the four-flip 405 candidate; no 185-bank rerun was done on 403/404 replay outputs.

current_to_matched_037_oriented_area_rat.definition: owner full_f32_area_gate current orientation ratio: dot(cross(F32_trial), cross(F64_baseline)) / ||cross(F64_baseline)||^2

surface_identity.comparison_semantics: The eight listed face rows are different triangles after the flips and are treated as changed topology, not matched surface identities. Identity equality is asserted only for the 41,725 unchanged rows. The 159 values are aggregate complete-audit counts over each full topology; they are not per-face correspondence claims.
